lines.text: Mempire's whole account layer is Mera. Watch a new player sign up: one passkey prompt, and that is the account.
The passkey's PRF output becomes the key, inside a Mera signing session. No seed phrase, no extension, nothing secret stored. The starter deck lands on chain in about ten seconds.
The same passkey-derived account signs real Monad transactions: here, minting a fighter at its live Pyth price.
In a staked match, a per-match session key signs every card, so a whole battle runs without a single wallet popup.
And Monad itself verifies a passkey signature, through its P-256 precompile, with a tampered copy refused.
